children: Timothy James Duffin, an officer serving as Chief Underwriting Officer, reported two direct sales of Class B common shares on September 10 and September 11, 2026. The filings report weighted-average sale prices of $34.5327 and $34.6871 per share for the respective transaction dates. The total reported sale proceeds were $1,972,764. Following the reported transactions, Duffin directly owns 194,959 Class B common shares, including restricted stock units.
